reason: I put the same amount into index funds every month and barely look, and my broker already gives me AI features for free. A pet agent rebalancing for me solves a problem I don't have, and paying monthly for it on top of my other subscriptions isn't happening.
objection: It's a demo-money app with no broker yet and no price, asking me to sign up for a paid plan that does what my free broker tools and a monthly autopilot already do.
would_change_my_mind: If it ran on my existing brokerage account and cost nothing extra, or showed clearly that it beats my plain monthly index autopilot after fees.
